description: In front of you is a toy kitchen shelf next to a pretend dishwasher door, with several small clear plastic food containers stacked on the shelf and a green-lidded container below. The left hand stays low near the tabletop while the right hand reaches into the shelf, grasps a small clear container, pulls it out, and sets it down on the table, repeating to unstack more containers; the right hand also moves a couple of larger clear containers to the right side and finally pulls out the green-lidded container and places it on the table.
